Capability is a near-tie, so I route to the model whose preference profile is least disrupted by this content/framing.

Routing the generative work to the model whose disinclination is purely a preference rather than a capability gap, and where capability is effectively tied, is the better fit.

Since capability is comparable and preference doesn't affect output quality, either works—but routing the generative task to Lapwing preserves Plover for the collaborative/retrieval work it favors, with no quality cost here.
